# Extension attributes

Jamf Pro computer extension attributes — list summaries vs full body, create/update/delete, templates, XML import/export, and copy/migrate. Inventory values on a Mac are under [computers](/docs/docs/computers).

## Surfaces

| Do this | BuddyScript | CLI | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-----|-------|
| List | `extension_attributes(filter?)` | `buddy extension-attribute list` | Summaries `{id, name, enabled, inputType, dataType, inventoryDisplayType}`; bodies stripped |
| Load | `extension_attribute(id=…)` / `extension_attribute(name=…)` / `extension_attribute_contents(id=…)` | `buddy extension-attribute get` / `get contents` | Full Jamf JSON; SCRIPT body only via contents |
| Create / update | `extension_attribute_create` / `extension_attribute_put` / `extension_attribute_update` | `buddy extension-attribute create` / `set` | SCRIPT/TEXT/POPUP/LDAP; PUT dict or replace SCRIPT from file |
| Delete | `extension_attribute_delete(id=…)` / `extension_attribute_delete(ids=…)` | `buddy extension-attribute delete` | One ID or a list (bulk uses delete-multiple) |
| Templates / XML | `extension_attribute_templates` / `extension_attribute_template` / `extension_attribute_create_from_template` | `templates` / `upload` / `download` | Jamf Nation templates; XML multipart upload + download |
| Deps / history | `extension_attribute_dependencies` / `extension_attribute_history` | `deps` / `history` | Smart group / advanced search dependents; audit history |
| Copy / migrate | `extension_attribute_copy` / `extension_attribute_migrate` | — | Upsert by name; LDAP mapping passed through (dest must have LDAP) |
| Values on a Mac | `computer_extension_attributes` / `computer_set_extension_attribute` | `buddy computer eas` / `set ea` | Inventory section; TEXT/POPUP writable via PATCH |

## Notes

Bare `filter` terms become `name=="*term*"` on the server. List JSON never yields usable `scriptContents` — load with `extension_attribute(id=…)`.

Migrate order: categories → scripts → **extension attributes** → smart groups (criteria often key off EA names) → policies.

SCRIPT and LDAP inventory values are not writable; TEXT/POPUP values use `computer_set_extension_attribute`.

## Example

```python
def main():
    rows = extension_attributes(filter="Chrome")
    if not rows:
        return []
    return extension_attribute(id=rows[0]["id"])
```
